findings.note: One English term, two spellings across the corpus: 'access' is एक्सेस (ए U+090F) in 21 pre-existing keys but ऐक्सेस (ऐ U+0910) here and in 2 pre-existing browser media-permission strings (ui.browser.media_access.system_blocked_hint, ui.browser.media_permission.system_blocked); the word is otherwise identical and neither the repo glossary nor the hi style guide binds the vowel, so this is a uniformity call and not a correction — 'खाते का एक्सेस दें' if the 21-key majority spelling is preferred. Non-gating: no same-screen mismatch, because the MCP sign-in dialog's own access wording is अनुमति (mcp_auth.grant_body), and both forms read as the same loanword.
